requirement.statement: The system SHALL load and validate canonical EagerDataFlow definitions and MUST reject removed DataFlow and lazy DataGraph authoring shapes.

case.then: the derived plan SHALL retain distinct data and completion edges

case.given: a DataFlow root or lazy graph node
case.then: loading SHALL fail without a compatibility alias

requirement.statement: The engine SHALL execute each ready node at most once, SHALL start independent ready nodes concurrently, and SHALL atomically publish validated output records.

case.given: a node with data inputs and waitFor dependencies
case.then: it SHALL start only after both dependency classes are satisfied

case.given: a ReturnNode captures output before another independent sink finishes
case.then: the invocation SHALL resolve only after all nodes converge

requirement.statement: SubFlowNode SHALL invoke a registered EagerDataFlow through its FlowContract, isolate child invocation state, and reject recursive unit call graphs.

case.when: the parent links and invokes it
case.then: input and output ports SHALL match the child contract exactly
